blocks.title: Computational biology
blocks.text: Computational biology ek bain-ul-ulomi (interdisciplinary) maidan hai jo hayatiyati (biological) masail hal karne ke liye computational techniques aur tools istemal karta hai. Yeh hayatiyati data ke tajziye (analysis) aur tashreeh ke liye biology, computer science, riyazi (mathematics) aur shumariyat (statistics) ka ilm jorta hai.

Is ki ahmiyat bare data sets sambhalne, chhupe namoone (patterns) dhundne aur aise peshgoi karne wale models banane ki salahiyat mein hai jo nayi hayatiyati basirat aur istemal tak le jayen. Is ke bare maidan genomics, proteomics aur bioinformatics hain.

items: Genomics genomes ka mutala hai, yani kisi jandar (organism) ke ek cell ke andar DNA ka mukammal majmua. Is mein genomes ki sequencing, jorna (assembling) aur un ke kaam aur banawat ka tajziya shamil hai, aur yeh genetic farq, gene ke kaam aur irtiqai (evolutionary) rishte samajhne mein madad deti hai.

Proteomics proteins ka bare paimane par mutala hai, un ki banawat aur kaam samet. Is ka maqsad kisi jandar ke banaye tamam proteins (proteome) ka naqsha banana aur cell ke amal mein un ke taalluqat aur kirdar samajhna hai.
Bioinformatics hayatiyati data ke intezam aur tajziye ke liye computer technology ka istemal hai. Is ke tools aur techniques DNA, RNA aur protein sequences ko zakheera, hasil aur tajziya karte hain.

Dawa ki daryaft: computational biology mumkina drug targets pehchanne aur hayatiyati nizamon par dawaon ke asraat ki naqal (simulate) karne mein madad deti hai, aur yeh peshgoi kar ke ke dawaein proteins aur doosre molecules se kaise taalluq rakhti hain dawa ki daryaft tez karti hai.

Genetic research: DNA sequences ka tajziya kar ke yeh beemariyon se juri genetic tabdeeliyan pehchanti hai, beemari ki genetic bunyad samajhne mein madad deti hai, aur personalised medicine tak le ja sakti hai.
Irtiqai biology: computational tools mukhtalif naslon (species) ki genetic maloomat ka muqabla karte hain, irtiqai rishte dobara banane aur irtiqa ka amal samajhne mein madad dete hain.

GenBank nucleotide sequences ka ek jame awami database hai jis ke saath kitabiyati aur hayatiyati annotations hain. Yeh bohat se jandaron ke DNA sequences ke wasee zakheere tak rasai deta hai, jo genetic research aur taqabuli (comparative) genomics mein madad karta hai.

Protein Data Bank (PDB) proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare hayatiyati molecules ka 3D banawati data deta hai. Yeh macromolecules ki banawat parhne, un ke kaam samajhne aur khaas protein banawaton ko nishana banane wali dawaein design karne ke liye aham hai.

Ensembl ek genome browser hai jo mukhtalif naslon ke genome sequences, gene models aur taqabuli genomics ki maloomat deta hai. Yeh genomic data tak rasai aur us ki tasveer-kashi mein madad deta hai, genomics aur irtiqai biology ke mutalon ko sahara dete hue.

BLAST (Basic Local Alignment Search Tool) bunyadi hayatiyati sequence maloomat ka muqabla karta hai, jaise proteins ke amino acid sequences ya DNA ke nucleotides. Yeh homologous sequences pehchanne, anjaan genes ke kaam ki peshgoi karne aur irtiqai rishte parhne mein madad karta hai.

FASTA ek sequence alignment tool hai jo ek query sequence ka sequences ke database se muqabla kar ke mushabahat ke hisse dhundta hai. Yeh protein aur nucleotide databases mein talash, sequence homology pehchanne aur sequence alignments ke tajziye mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ke paas ek anjaan protein ka amino acid sequence hai. Us ki banawat aur kaam ki peshgoi ke liye kaun sa tool aur kaun se do databases istemal karenge, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Sequence ko BLAST ya FASTA se GenBank ya protein sequence records ke khilaf chalayen taake aise homologous sequences milen jin ke kaam maloom hain, kyunke homologues aam taur par kaam share karte hain. Phir Protein Data Bank mein kisi qareebi homologue ki 3D banawat dhunden, jis se anjaan protein ki banawat model aur us ka active site peshgoi kiya ja sakta hai.

items: Computational biology bare data sambhalne, namoone dhundne aur peshgoi karne wale models banane ke liye biology, computer science, riyazi aur shumariyat jorti hai. Maidan: genomics (genomes), proteomics (proteome), bioinformatics (sequence data ka intezam).
Istemal: dawa ki daryaft, genetic research aur personalised medicine, irtiqai biology.
Databases: GenBank (nucleotide sequences), Protein Data Bank (3D banawat), Ensembl (genome browser). Algorithms: sequence ke muqable aur homology ke liye BLAST aur FASTA.
